Thus no legitimate D, Delta > 0, and tau can satisfy clause (iii).

source_evidence.claim: Difficulty 1 is the one-creature profile with no return blossom, high canopy, or overhang.

Render initializes a local state from the settled board and selects the configured full mode.
State changes are triggered by move, undo, reset, submit, or full-mode keydown handlers; the initial draw is otherwise static.
The mechanic CSS contains layout, hover/focus, media, and disabled styles but no autonomous animation or transition.
The grader replays only the submitted discrete action transcript, checks the mode-specific keyboard input source, and evaluates the final solved state without task-time evolution.
The solver performs ordinary body-click plus keyboard actions in full mode and card plus direction-button actions in simplified mode; its waits are solver pacing, not game mechanics.
